source: The New York Times Developer Portal FAQ
question: 11. Is there an API call limit?
official_answer: Yes, there are two rate limits per API: 500 requests per day and 5 requests per minute. You should sleep 12 seconds between calls to avoid hitting the per minute rate limit. If you need a higher rate limit, please contact us at code@nytimes.com.
note: The previous 13-second interval was only slightly more conservative than the official recommendation. Higher request rates require NYT approval; pagination remains 10 articles per page.
